title: Allow dragging files onto the “Send file” pseudo-folder to instantly initiate file transfer
line: Files dropped or pasted onto a device's Send File entry in Dolphin's bluetooth:/ view are now sent to that device right away, without the wizard.
explanation: In a device's bluetooth:/ folder, Send File was listed as a plain file whose only action was opening the send wizard, so file managers refused drops on it and the user had to pick the files again in the wizard. The kio_bluetooth worker had no way to receive files at all. The worker now lists Send File as a writable folder and implements copy from local files: each file copied, moved or pasted into it gets its own Object Push session to that device through obexd, with KIO's usual progress, cancel and error reporting. Dolphin also stops saying "No Bluetooth devices found" inside a device's folders (it now says "Folder is empty" there), since that text only makes sense for the device list.

commits.message:
kio/bluetooth: send files dropped or pasted onto Send File

The Send File entry in a device's bluetooth:/ folder only opened the
wizard, so files couldn't be dropped onto it. It is now a folder: files
copied into it are sent to that device over Object Push with progress.

BUG: 263750

DolphinView: say "No Bluetooth devices found" only in bluetooth:/

Every empty bluetooth: folder said that no Bluetooth devices were found,
including a device's folders such as its Send File folder, where it is
wrong. The text is now only shown for the device list at bluetooth:/.
